provenance.tool: hand computation; tests/reference/derive_inc_scn.py (Python 3.13 standard library: csv, fractions, decimal)
provenance.steps: I = client_rate(t-1) - (R(t-L, T) + m) - penalty, with L = 1 (M4), so the curve is read at the month end before t: 2024-02-29 for t = 2024-03-31 and 2024-04-30 for t = 2024-05-31. At both dates every configured EUR series (EUR_SWAP_12M, _60M, _120M) is 0, so R = 0 for every T and under any compounding convention; at 2024-01-31, 2024-03-31 and 2024-05-31 they are not 0, nor are the unconfigured EUR_OIS_24M and the USD series at any date, so a wrong lag, a wrong series or a wrong currency changes I. T is supplied in years (term_years). Margins m: MTG_FIX 0.005, MTG_RST 0.0075, CON_FIX 0.012. Penalty: PCT value / max(T, 1); MONTHS_INTEREST value x client_rate / 12 / max(T, 1); NONE 0. A1: 0.04 - 0.005 = 0.035. A2: 0.02 / 4 = 0.005, I = 0.03. A3 (T = 0.5) and A4 (T = 1): 0.02 / 1 = 0.02, I = 0.015. B1: 3 x 0.036 / 12 / 2.5 = 0.0036, I = 0.036 - 0.0075 - 0.0036 = 0.0249. B2 (T = 0.25): 6 x 0.06 / 12 / 1 = 0.03, I = 0.06 - 0.012 - 0.03 = 0.018. B3: -0.002 - 0.005 = -0.007. B4: 0.015 / 1.5 = 0.01, I = 0.055 - 0.012 - 0.01 = 0.033. B5 (T = 0.75): 2 x 0.03 / 12 / 1 = 0.005, I = 0.03 - 0.0075 - 0.005 = 0.0175. The script recomputes every value exactly in rationals and checks that the configured curve is 0 at each rate date. Term ends, by hand at t-1 = 2024-02-29: F1 FIXED ends at maturity_date; R1 RESET in its fixed period ends at fixed_until; R2 RESET past fixed_until has no incentive; R3 RESET whose fixed_until falls inside month t is still in its fixed period at t-1; V1 FLOAT has no incentive. The year fraction from these dates to T is not stated by the contract and is not tested.
